tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Studio background and figure cards. Cards get a soft lighter centre (#1a3a7a).

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: 16px caption stroke, 10px hard drop shadow, and the text in label boxes.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Yellow. The key word in a caption, the row that matters, the lower-third tag.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Green. Numbers and wins: "5 HOURS", "BACK". At most one per phrase.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin for figure rows and the lower third on a 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: caption-top
tokens.usage: Top of the caption block: under the face, over the hands.

tokens.name: label-top
tokens.usage: Top of the title label box (170px in from each side).

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep all text at least this far from every frame edge, and 300px clear of the bottom (app buttons).

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Boxes and rows arriving: scale 0.6 to 1 with overshoot. Words use back.out(3).

tokens.name: word-pop
tokens.usage: One caption word popping in on its spoken time.

tokens.name: enter
tokens.usage: A label box, tag or figure row popping in.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between two boxes of one lower third. Figure rows: 0.35s.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum time a phrase stays on screen to be read.
